REED-BURN.title: Burn
REED-BURN.description: Deal damage to a creature's Resistance. When its Resistance reaches 0, the creature enters [red]Burning State[/red].
REED-RESISTANCE.title: Resistance
REED-RESISTANCE.description: When Resistance reaches 0, the creature enters [red]Burning State[/red].
REED-BURNING.title: Burning State
REED-BURNING.description:
[red]Burning Continues[/red]
Whenever you play a card, this creature restores 1 Resistance. It leaves this state when its Resistance is fully restored.
REED-ATTACH.title: Attach
REED-ATTACH.description: Attach a card to a creature. If this would exceed the limit, choose an attached card to [gold]Detonate[/gold] first.
REED-FIRE_FLOWER.title: Spark
REED-FIRE_FLOWER.description: When the creature this card is attached to enters [red]Burning State[/red], trigger this card's [gold]Burst[/gold] effect.
REED-STEP.title: Evolve
REED-STEP.description: Normally, 3 Spark Cards with the [gold]same name[/gold] merge into a higher-tier Spark Card.
REED-UNYIELDING.title: Everburning
REED-UNYIELDING.description: When this card is Exhausted, add a copy of it to your hand.
REED-IGNITE.title: Detonate
REED-IGNITE.description: Trigger a Spark Card's Burst effect, then remove it.
REED-MEMORY.title: Memory
REED-MEMORY.description: Whenever you [gold]manually play[/gold] an Attack, Skill, or Power card, record it in Memory.
REED-RECALL.title: Recall
REED-RECALL.description: Choose a card from Memory, play a copy of it, then remove it from Memory.
REED-FUTURE.title: Tara Will Have a Future
REED-FUTURE.description: But that future will no longer be yours.
